title: Zesty and Zingy Japanese Lentils Kanto Tan-Tan-Udon
description: A flavorful, pillowy, and crowd-pleasing Japanese dish from the Kanto region featuring lentils and a zesty sauce.
instructions: Combine 1 cup of red lentils and 4 cups of broth in a large pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until the lentils are tender.

While the lentils are cooking, combine 2 tablespoons of rice vinegar, 2 inches of grated ginger, 1 tablespoon of sesame oil, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, and 1 teaspoon of sugar in a small saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add 1 envelope of spherification agent to the sauce and stir to combine.
Once the lentils are cooked, drain and rinse them with cold water.
Add the cooked lentils to the sauce and stir to combine.
Add 1 cup of water to the sauce and stir to combine.
Meanwhile, cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
Once the noodles are cooked, drain and rinse them with cold water.
Add the cooked noodles to the lentil mixture and stir to combine.
Garnish with 1/2 cup of green onions and 1/4 cup of toasted sesame seeds.
